stops.note: to drive off the stage by clapping or hissing, from ex- and plaudere
stops.meaning: to drive off the stage by clapping or hissing

stops.note: settled as the English word originally for rejecting scornfully, later shifting to mean bursting violently
stops.meaning: to reject scornfully, later to burst violently

current_meaning: to burst suddenly and violently, often with a loud noise
